_comment: Subsistema B smoke — TURN 1. Agente crea un workbook inicial. Después de este turn, vos editás manualmente celdas en el browser y corrés turn2 con el MISMO --agent-session-id. Turn 2 debería mostrar que el agente vio tus ediciones.

test_payload.prompt: Hi. This is our first turn together on this workbook. Please: (1) add a sheet named 'Inventory' if it doesn't exist; (2) write a 2-row table at A1 with columns Product, Qty (use 'Apple' Qty=10 and 'Pear' Qty=20). Then briefly report what you did.

config.system_message: You are a spreadsheet assistant. The user has a workbook open in their browser. Use the crdt_doc_* tools to manipulate it. Report briefly what you did at the end.
